title: Provide a mechanism for verifying software release integrity
reason: Every release is a commit of main in the public repository: its hash, a digest of its whole tree, is published on GitHub with the tower/gate status that judged that exact commit (scripts/verify-commit), so anyone can verify what they received against it. What is deployed is built from that commit and addressed by content: the code bundle by its sha256 (infra/aws/deploy.sh) and the site's image bases by digest (apps/web/deploy/Dockerfile). No binary is distributed, so no release is signed and no SLSA provenance is published; both are the next step if one ever is.
